meta.name: English
meta.note: key 是中文原文，value 是英文译文。缺失的条目自动回退中文。

strings.0 最快、11 最小。9 是体积/速度平衡点；11 在 100MB 上可能要几十: 0 is fastest, 11 is smallest. 9 balances size and speed; 11 can take tens of seconds on 100 MB.
strings.0 表示本次会话内一直保持解锁。: 0 means stay unlocked for the whole session.
strings.AES-GCM 认证失败，记录密文被改动或损坏：: AES-GCM authentication failed; the record ciphertext was altered or damaged:
strings.Custom 表示沿用界面上的百分比定位；选具体锚点后按「锚点 + 偏移(mm): Custom keeps the percentage position; a concrete anchor uses anchor + offset (mm).
strings.Custom 表示沿用界面上的百分比定位；选具体锚点后改为「锚点 + 边距 +: Custom keeps the percentage position from the main page; a concrete anchor switches to anchor + margin + offset.
strings.ECIES 的密钥派生上下文，改了两边必须一致。: Key derivation context for ECIES; both sides must match if changed.
strings.RTF 忽略型目标组的名字。: Name of a destination group that RTF ignores.
strings.SHA3-512 前 8 字节与 footer 记录一致。: The first 8 bytes of SHA3-512 match the footer.
strings.ZIP 规范硬上限 65535，超了只能重打包。: Hard ZIP limit is 65535; beyond that the archive has to be rebuilt.
strings.{0} 字节，尾部标记与长度字段自洽。: {0} bytes; trailer marker and length field are consistent.
strings.{0} 条记录的盖章时间依次递增，没有倒挂。: Seal times of {0} records increase in order with no inversions.
strings.不提供章也可以验证：能确认记录未被改动，但无法证明它来自谁。: Verifying without a seal is possible: it confirms the record was not altered, but cannot prove who issued it.
strings.两处 PBKDF2 记录一致，且与章字节重算结果相同。: Both PBKDF2 records agree and match the recomputation from the seal bytes.
strings.两次输入的口令不一致。: The two passphrases do not match.
strings.也可以用系统自带的画图 / Illustrator 做好 SVG 再导入。: You can also prepare an SVG in Paint or Illustrator and import it.
strings.也可以直接把文件或一批文件拖进这里: You can also drag files or a whole folder here
strings.仅在目标图片为 JPEG 或需要重新编码时使用。: Only used for JPEG targets or when re-encoding is required.
strings.任何一项校验失败都判为失败（关闭时仅警告）。: Any failed check counts as a failure (warning only when disabled).
strings.低于该版本时可能出现界面错位、WebView2 组件缺失等问题，这些不在支持范围: Older builds may show layout problems or a missing WebView2 runtime; those are not supported.
strings.例如：仅用于 XX 项目内部文件，不代表法律效力: e.g. Internal use for project XX; not legally binding
strings.信封声明的总长（{0}）与实读长度（{1}）不一致，文件可能被追加过其它数据。: Declared total length ({0}) differs from the actual length ({1}); data may have been appended.
strings.关闭时每次启动都按默认尺寸（1920×1080）打开；开启则用上次关闭时的位置和: Off: opens at the default 1920×1080 every time. On: reuses the last position and size.
strings.加密节2 由章的公钥加密，必须提供原章（私钥）才能解开。: Section 2 is encrypted to the seal public key; the original seal (private key) is required.
strings.加载时先检查结构（zip/7z/pdf）是否完整，避免把损坏文件改坏。: Checks the container structure (zip/7z/pdf) before loading, so a damaged file is not made worse.
strings.压缩后反而更大时原样保存。: Stores the original when compression makes it larger.
strings.原文件内容与盖章时不一致：盖章时 {0}…，现在 {1}…: File content differs from sealing time: {0}… then, {1}… now
strings.口令至少 4 个字符（建议更长）。: The passphrase needs at least 4 characters (longer is better).
strings.只摘除本程序写入的记录，文件其它内容不变；章删除后需要重新盖章才能恢复。是否继续: Only the record written by this app is removed; the rest of the file is untouched. Once removed, the seal must be applied again to restore it. Continue?
strings.图案渲染失败，无法可视化盖章。: Artwork rendering failed; visual sealing is unavailable.
strings.在图片 / PDF 上贴出图案: Stamp the artwork onto images / PDF
strings.多枚章时检查盖章时间是否倒挂。: Checks for out-of-order timestamps when a file carries several seals.
strings.存在时间倒挂（后写入的记录反而更早），可能被工具回填过时间：: Timestamps are out of order (a later record is earlier); a tool may have backdated them:
strings.存在章里，换电脑也能用；盖章时可选择是否贴到图片 / PDF 上。: Stored in the seal file and usable on another PC; choose whether to stamp it onto images / PDF.
strings.小于该值直接不压缩，省 CPU。: Files below this size are not compressed, saving CPU.
strings.已按设置跳过（高级设置 → 验证 → 校验原文件摘要）。: Skipped per settings (Options → Verification → Verify original hash).
strings.已按设置跳过（高级设置 → 验证 → 校验章身份）。: Skipped per settings (Options → Verification → Verify seal identity).
strings.已按设置跳过（高级设置 → 验证 → 校验记录自身哈希）。: Skipped per settings (Options → Verification → Verify record hash).
strings.已有章文件？去盖章页载入: Already have a seal file? Load it on the Seal page
strings.已用章私钥解密，取出章字节 {0} 字节。: Decrypted with the seal private key; {0} bytes of seal data retrieved.
strings.已解密（KDF {0} 次，ECIES 临时公钥 {1} 字节）。: Decrypted (KDF {0} iterations, ECIES ephemeral key {1} bytes).
strings.当前章不含图案，无法可视化盖章。: This seal has no artwork, so visual sealing is unavailable.
strings.影响进度刷新粒度与内存占用。: Affects progress granularity and memory use.
strings.所有可调参数都在这里；改完点「保存设置」写入程序目录 config\\setti: All tunable options live here. Click "Save settings" to write them to config\settings.json next to the program.
strings.把所有参数恢复为默认值？当前设置会被覆盖（不会立即写盘，点「保存设置」才生效）。: Restore all options to defaults? Current settings will be overwritten (nothing is saved until you click Save settings).
strings.把章写进文件的空白区：只追加、不覆盖已有内容，原文件照常打开。: Writes the seal into a file's unused space: append-only, nothing overwritten, the file still opens normally.
strings.拖动预览里的章可调位置，拖右下角改大小；PDF 页码填 0 表示全部页。预览用当: Drag the seal in the preview to move it, drag its bottom-right corner to resize. A PDF page of 0 means all pages. The preview uses the real page of the selected file, so what you see is what gets stamped.
strings.描述（写进记录，验章时显示）: Description (stored in the record, shown on verification)
strings.操作短于该时间就完全不显示，避免闪烁。: Operations shorter than this are not shown at all, avoiding flicker.
strings.文件尾部数据不符合 SymbolPrint 信封格式（尾部标记损坏或记录被截断）: Trailing data is not a valid SymbolPrint envelope (marker damaged or record truncated).
strings.文件里只有一条记录，无需比较顺序。: Only one record in the file; nothing to compare.
strings.新建章时默认勾选口令保护。: Pre-checks passphrase protection for new seals.
strings.无法取出记录里的原文件摘要，因此不能证明原文件未被改动。: The original hash cannot be recovered, so the file content cannot be proven unchanged.
strings.无法用该章的私钥解开加密节2：: Cannot decrypt section 2 with this seal private key:
strings.无章时提示局限性: Warn about limits when no seal
strings.无章验证只能证明「这段盖章记录本身没有被改动」，不能证明「文件是由谁盖的章」。要: Verifying without a seal only proves this record was not altered; it cannot prove who issued it. To confirm the origin, provide the original .bin seal file.
strings.曲线越长越安全、签名越大；P-256 已足够: Longer curves are safer but produce larger signatures; P-256 is enough
strings.有 {0} 个文件已经带盖章记录：: {0} file(s) already carry a seal record:
strings.本程序面向 Windows 10 22H2（build 19045）及以上，当前: This app targets Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later; the current build is {0}.
strings.没有可用的图案：请选择 .svg/.png，或使用含图案的章。: No artwork available: choose a .svg/.png, or use a seal that carries artwork.
strings.没有盖章记录时，无法证明这个文件的来源，也无法证明它没有被改动过（任何人都可以换: Without a record there is no way to prove where this file came from or that it was not altered (anyone could substitute other content). If it should carry a seal, check whether another tool re-saved the file — some tools drop data at the end of the file.
strings.没有章的文件只能证明「当前内容未被改动」，不能证明来源。: Without a seal, a file only proves its content is unchanged, not who issued it.
strings.生成一个 .bin 章文件：内含 ECC 密钥、章字节、描述与图案。私钥可用口令: Creates a .bin seal file containing the ECC keys, seal bytes, description and artwork. The private key can be protected with a passphrase.
strings.用于二进制 0/1 的两个码点，逗号分隔十六进制。: Two code points used for bits 0 and 1, comma-separated hex.
strings.用口令保护私钥（推荐）: Protect the private key with a passphrase (recommended)
strings.用章内公钥重算指纹，确认章文件未被替换。: Recomputes the fingerprint from the seal's public key to confirm the seal file was not swapped.
strings.盖章前把原文件复制一份 .bak，失败时可回滚。: Copies the original to .bak before sealing so it can be rolled back.
strings.目前只支持 .svg 和 .png 作为图案。: Only .svg and .png are supported as artwork.
strings.程序生成的内容为空，请点「重新生成」。: Generated content is empty; click Regenerate.
strings.程序遇到未处理的错误：: The program hit an unhandled error:
strings.章字节可以是任意内容：一段授权说明、一个序列号，或由程序生成的一份清单。\r\n:
Seal bytes can be anything: a license note, a serial number, or a list generated by the app.
A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered, so keep the .bin and the passphrase separate.
strings.章字节可以是任意内容：一段授权说明、一个序列号，或由程序生成的一份清单。 口令一: Seal bytes can be anything: a license note, a serial number, or a list generated by the app. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered, so keep the .bin and the passphrase separate.
strings.章字节的 PBKDF2 指纹对不上：加密节1、加密节2 与章字节三者不一致。: Seal-bytes PBKDF2 mismatch: section 1, section 2 and the seal bytes disagree.
strings.章的私钥受口令保护，请输入口令后点「载入」。: The seal private key is passphrase-protected. Enter the passphrase and click Load.
strings.章私钥默认口令保护: Protect seal private key by default
strings.继续盖章会在文件里再追加一条记录（旧记录保留）。是否继续？: Sealing again appends another record (the old one is kept). Continue?
strings.耗时未知的计算显示转圈动画。: Shows a spinner for work of unknown duration.
strings.记录内嵌的 SHA3-512 与实际内容不符，记录已被篡改。: The embedded SHA3-512 does not match the content; the record was tampered with.
strings.记录声明的章指纹与提供的章一致（{0}）。: The declared seal fingerprint matches the provided seal ({0}).
strings.记录声明的章指纹为 {0}，但未提供原章，无法核对。: The record declares seal fingerprint {0}, but no seal was provided for comparison.
strings.记录声明的章指纹（{0}）与提供的章（{1}）不同 —— 这个章不是当初盖章用的: The declared fingerprint ({0}) differs from the provided seal ({1}) — this is not the seal that was used.
strings.记录头、密钥、密文的 SHA3-512 与内嵌摘要一致。: The SHA3-512 of header, key and ciphertext matches the embedded digest.
strings.该文件的空白区里没有 SymbolPrint 盖章记录。: No SymbolPrint record in this file's unused space.
strings.详细信息已写入日志：: Details were written to the log:
strings.请先在左边列表里选中要删除章的文件（可按住 Ctrl 多选）。: Select the file(s) to unseal in the list on the left (hold Ctrl for multiple).
strings.请先添加要盖章的文件。: Add the files to seal first.
strings.请先添加要盖章的文件（左侧列表）。: Add the files to seal first (list on the left).
strings.请先选择并载入章文件（右侧「印章文件」卡片）。: Choose and load a seal file first (Seal file card on the right).
strings.请填一个标签，方便以后认出这个章。: Give it a label so you can recognise this seal later.
strings.请点「选择…」指定一个 .svg / .png 图案，或改用自带图案的章。: Click Browse… to pick a .svg / .png, or use a seal that carries artwork.
strings.请选择作为章字节的文件（或改用文本 / 程序生成）。: Choose a file to use as seal bytes (or switch to Text / Generated).
strings.读取章字节文件失败：: Failed to read the seal-bytes file:
strings.贴图前备份原文件（.bak）: Back up the original before stamping (.bak)
strings.越高越抗暴力破解，也越慢。默认 40000 在普通机器上约 250ms。: Higher is harder to brute-force but slower. The default 40000 takes about 250 ms on a typical machine.
strings.载荷 SHA3-512 与 footer 记录不一致，记录内容已被改动。: Payload SHA3-512 does not match the footer; the record was altered.
strings.还原后的原文件 SHA3-512 与盖章时记录的一致 —— 原文件内容未被改动。: The restored SHA3-512 matches the sealed value — the file content is unchanged.
strings.这一段会作为「章字节」原样加密进记录（UTF-8 编码）: Stored as the seal bytes, encrypted exactly as written (UTF-8)
strings.选择文件后点「开始验证」。: Choose a file, then click Start.
strings.逐项检查盖章记录、章身份与文件内容，并说明结论的适用范围。: Checks the seal record, seal identity and file content item by item, and states how far the conclusion reaches.
strings.避免遮挡正文。: Keeps the artwork from covering body text.
strings.重启后生效。System 跟随 Windows 的应用主题设置。: Takes effect after restart. System follows the Windows app theme setting.
strings.重启后生效。System 跟随 Windows 的显示语言。: Takes effect after restart. System follows the Windows display language.
strings.重启后生效。System 跟随 Windows 的显示语言。zh_AL 为文言风: Takes effect after restart. System follows the Windows display language. zh_AL is the classical Chinese style.
strings.重编码图片时保留原始 EXIF。: Keeps the original EXIF when re-encoding images.
